Exercises {@link LineIterator#isValidLine} filtering using the given reader.

The override rejects lines whose trailing digit satisfies {@code digit % 3 == 1}, i.e. it skips lines ending in '1', '4', and '7'. For a 9-line file (LINE 0 … LINE 8) this leaves 6 valid lines.
Reject lines whose trailing digit is congruent to 1 mod 3 (i.e. lines ending in '1', '4', '7').
Skip the filtered-out index (every third position starting at 1: 1, 4, 7) so that idx stays aligned with the original lines list.
